died of old age in office

claims.en: director of the Palace of Everlasting Faith

translationRepairs: Men like Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yanshou, and Zhang Chang filled their offices competently, yet built their reputations on harsh law; several ended condemned and put to death.
Men like Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yannian, and Zhang Chang filled their offices competently, yet built their reputations on harsh law; several ended condemned and put to death.

Focus unit lists 嚴延年 after 尹翁歸; that given name is Yannian (年), not Yanshou (壽). The prior idiomatic wrongly copies Han Yanshou's given name onto Yan. The proposed replacement restores the correct name without other changes.
Such as Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yanshou, Zhang Chang and their kind, all matched their positions, yet relied on punishments; some met crime and execution.
Such as Zhao Guanghan, Han Yanshou, Yin Wenggui, Yan Yannian, Zhang Chang and their kind, all matched their positions, yet relied on punishments; some met crime and execution.
Focus unit 嚴延年 is Yan Yannian; the prior literal renders him as Yan Yanshou by contamination from adjacent 韓延壽. Correcting only that name matches the Chinese.
History shows every era advances its own capable men. If you insist on waiting for another yiyin day or Lü Shang, talent will pass you by—those men will never owe their careers to you."
History shows every era advances its own capable men. If you insist on waiting for another Yi Yin or Lü Shang, talent will pass you by—those men will never owe their careers to you."

Focus unit 若必伊尹、呂望 pairs the Shang minister Yi Yin with Lü Wang; 伊尹 is a personal name, not a sexagenary 'yiyin day'. The proposed idiomatic repair corrects that misreading and leaves the rest intact.
By precedent each reaches his age's heroes; if one must wait for yiyin day and Lü Wang and afterward recommend them, then this person will not because of you, sir, advance."
By precedent each reaches his age's heroes; if one must wait for Yi Yin and Lü Wang and afterward recommend them, then this person will not because of you, sir, advance."
Focus unit 伊尹 is the personal name Yi Yin parallel to 呂望; 'yiyin day' is a mistranslation. The proposed literal correction is accurate.

Few officials then won renown for civilizing rule through moral example; only Jiangdu Chancellor Dong Zhongshu, Capital Superintendent Gongsun Hong, and Kuan (the manuscript omits one character of his surname), among others, left careers worth remembering.
Few officials then won renown for civilizing rule through moral example; only Jiangdu Chancellor Dong Zhongshu, Capital Superintendent Gongsun Hong, and Ni Kuan left careers worth remembering.
Wikisource preserves 兒寬, and the same official is repeatedly named Ni Kuan elsewhere in the corpus. This removes a scrape-lacuna note and restores the received personal name.
